doc.title: Pug Horton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998

title: Closing thoughts and goodbyes
summary: She still is moved by old recordings; the interview ends with thanks.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: And listening to some of your favorite singers.

That I have very little time to do. But I have to say that when I do there are things that absolutely still knock me out, things, the old things that I’ve heard over and over and over and over again. I still am totally moved to tears by a lot of the things that I’ve been listening to for all these years.
I guess that’s why they call it classic.
Well it’s been great talking to you and I’m so glad you’re on the campus here for the weekend. Enjoy the rest of the weekend.
And I hope we run into each other again soon.
Wouldn’t that be nice, yes. Thank you, Monk, it was lovely.
